purpose: Close the active B1 likelihood and independent-mock contracts without opening an observational posterior or reading GPFS artifacts.

supersedes.policy: The earlier result remains immutable history; this amendment is the effective B1 contract addendum.

authorization.basis: User approval on 2026-09-04 for one consolidated B1 closure amendment.

density_factor.datum: six integer N32 count grids and raw selection exposure
density_factor.object_overlap_policy: exclude the 17,007 securely crossmatched 2M++ targets before binning

velocity_factor.datum: grouped CF4 distance and radial-velocity marks
velocity_factor.shared_latent: one shared redshift latent per canonical secure CF4 1PGC group

active_B1_factorization.dependence_policy: The factors share the latent z=0 field and declared nuisance parameters; object-level redshift reuse is forbidden. Disjoint objects do not imply independent cosmic-field or catalog-systematic errors.
active_B1_factorization.posterior_promotion: forbidden until the development-mock and held-out gates below pass

selection_contract.definition: Cartesian product of K<=11.5 or 11.5<K<=12.5 with three equal-width absolute-K bins over -25<M_K<-21

angular_response.source: official ARES/BORG NSIDE=512 RING completeness maps
angular_response.coordinate_convention: verified equatorial convention, sampled after supergalactic-to-ICRS transformation

radial_response.source: six-population Schechter response under the frozen cosmology
radial_response.population_mean_density: six nuisance normalizations with external calibration priors

voxel_integration.normalization: never rescale exposure to observed population totals

selection_contract.artifact_use: A source-bound selection artifact must be available before inference; this amendment records the contract but performs no external read.

redshift_space_and_deposition_contract.line_of_sight: observer-centred spherical rhat(x), recomputed at every source location
redshift_space_and_deposition_contract.small_scale_broadening: population-specific positive FoG dispersion combined in quadrature with measurement-redshift uncertainty

predicted_intensity.deposition: periodic conservative differentiable TSC push with tested adjoint
predicted_intensity.mass_conservation: required in the R_p=1 synthetic limit

boundary_policy.observer_sphere: finite radial support inside the periodic box
boundary_policy.maximum_displacement: must remain below the declared sphere-to-face margin
boundary_policy.periodic_images: suppressed by the support contract; no silent image contribution

population_normalization.parameterization: alpha_p on an unconstrained log-intensity scale
population_normalization.prior: external luminosity-function/selection calibration; observed totals may not set the prior centre

luminosity_bias.prior: population-specific calibration prior; a universal scalar bias is forbidden

nuisance_and_discrepancy_contract.baseline_count_model: independent Poisson conditional on positive selected intensity

model_discrepancy.form: smooth, low-rank log-intensity discrepancy templates with shrinkage priors
constraints: templates are frozen before validation truth is opened
zero monopole after the eta gauge is applied
must not absorb retained cosmological modes or move the k frontier
model_discrepancy.alternative_model_decision: select or reject only from development-mock evidence, then evaluate once on untouched validation mocks

identifiability_reports: local Hessian or Fisher singular values

cf4_covariance_and_overlap_contract.group_redshift_covariance: Sherman-Morrison shared-latent covariance per canonical CF4 group; no independent 2M++ Vcmb term
cf4_covariance_and_overlap_contract.residual_dependence: Common eta_z0 and declared nuisance parameters remain shared. Disjoint-object filtering is not treated as proof of zero catalog-systematic covariance.
cf4_covariance_and_overlap_contract.failure_rule: If a development mock shows material residual cross-factor covariance not represented by the declared latent/nuisance model, posterior promotion is blocked and the contract must be amended before validation.

structure_summary_scope.role_in_B1: held as preregistered validation targets and future structure-conditioned factors, not independent likelihood terms
structure_summary_scope.reason: Complete provenance, uncertainty, covariance, and forward-discrepancy contracts are not yet bound.
structure_summary_scope.no_claim: No B1 posterior may claim that these structures are observationally reconstructed solely from the active field factors.

independent_mock_firewall.seed_policy: seed ranges and assignment are frozen before candidate or validation inspection; no seed or parent ranking

development.assignment: 16 mocks per arm A-D, each seed exactly once

untouched_validation.assignment: sealed until all code, nuisance priors, discrepancy basis, bins and gates are frozen
untouched_validation.purpose: one-time coverage, held-out prediction and frontier validation

arms.truth: positive Poisson intensity with coherent spherical RSD
coherent RSD plus population-dependent FoG and redshift errors
overdispersed/HOD counts with selection perturbation and smooth discrepancy

independent_mock_firewall.truth_source: same predeclared generator family and frozen LCDM covariance; TNG100 may inform nuisance distributions but cannot supply 384 cMpc/h cosmic-variance truth
independent_mock_firewall.data_split: row-level deterministic split before voxelization; no spatially adjacent holdout
independent_mock_firewall.execution_state: bindings frozen, mocks not executed in this amendment

required_before_observational_posterior: positive Poisson intensity and zero-support rejection
independent development calibration across arms A-D
strict contiguous density, velocity and joint k-frontier gates
promotion_gates.frontier_rule: all declared bins from k_f through the declared analysis Nyquist; first failed bin terminates the contiguous prefix
promotion_gates.high_k_completion: conditional/prior-dominated until the above gates pass

closure_decision.next_single_bundle_action: Diagnose the remaining information loss and estimator/field parameterization without opening validation seeds; then update the B1 dossier and request closure audit.
